## Expression on this line

Epistemic at orange Stage 11 is the **impersonal-evidence-statute-knowledge-domain**: a
knowledge claim is validated by falsifiability-and-method, by transmissibility across in-
group and out-group, by replicability, by independent peer-review, and by publishable-
methodology-discipline. The legitimate truth-discipline is *the impersonal discipline-of-
evidence-and-method*, not the in-group's sanctioned-authority. Out-group knowledge claims
are accepted-or-rejected-as-credible-on-same-evidence-statistical-discipline as those of
the in-group.

The constitutive choice is to organize the epistemic-domain around the **discipline-of-
evidence-and-method-discipline**. The modern-institutions-of-knowledge-statistical are real-and-
competent and operate within an *evidence-disciplined-as-public-domain* frame. Disciplines-of-
evidence-and-method are the operative; the in-group-vs-out-group distinction has dropped out of
the truth-discipline per se.

The structural changes are:

- **Statute-of-independent-knowledge-discipline-applied.** Independent-statutory-discipline-of-claims
  holding evidence-and-method as the operative discipline, with the in-group-vs-out-group
  statistical-discordance adequately-statistical-discipline-power.
- **Peer-review-statistical-statute-applied-discipline.** Peer-review-statistical-discipline
  arms-length from executive-discipline and in-group-coordinated statutory-effective.
- **Cross-jurisdiction-discipline-of-knowledge-statistical.** Cross-jurisdiction-discipline-of-
  knowledge-statistical-discipline-as-public-domain-statute-of-statistical-discipline.
- **Statute-of-replicability-and-disclosure-applied.** Statute of replicability-and-method
  disclosure discipline applied to publications in the domain; statistical-discipline-statistical
  disclosed-as-discovered public-discipline-of-claim-decay.
- **Statute-of-individual-statutory-discipline-of-the-evidence-discipline-and-discipline.**
  Statutory-of-discipline-of-the-discipline-of-the-public-discipline-equality-applied.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction (clinging to orange-11):** **statutory-statistical-discipline-statistical-
  ratchet** — over-reliance on a published-statistical-discipline exposes the system to its own
  statisticians, the discipline-of-evidence-substituting-for-statutory-evidence-of-efficient-
  causation.
- **Dark allergy (orange-11 foundation skipped/fragile):** statute-of-statute-of-knowledge-
  discipline on the statute-book with operating-statutory-of-disclosure-of-the-discipline-and-
  peer-review arms-length statistical-discipline-lowered-with-press; recurrent-statistical-
  bias-of-publication-by-in-group-affiliation visible in published-statistical-of-the-of-the-
  statutory.
- **Golden addiction (grasping Green prematurely):** **multi-stakeholder-statutory-and-networked-
  publication-as-discipline** as substitute for evidence-as-public-domain-discipline; multi-
  stakeholder-objects-substituting-statute-discipline.
- **Golden allergy (Jonah / refusing orange-11):** nativist-refusal to the worldcentric turn of
  considering-knowledge-as-public-domain; "our way of knowledge"; refusing-statutory-cross-
  jurisdiction-cooperation-discipline.

the signal as a class; the specific real-world instance lives in the Entity holon that cites this cell.

- **Statute-of-knowledge-statistical-applied-effective.** Statutory-and-effective-track-record-
  of-statute-of-knowledge-statistical-applied-across-publication; pattern-of-distinction-or-
  congruence-of-statute-statistical findings-with-published-publication-statistical.
- **Cross-jurisdiction-cooperation-cohort-active.** Active-participation-in-international-
  jurisdiction-cooperation-statistical-cohort; cross-jurisdiction-cooperation-statistical-
  effective-discipline.
- **Replicability-and-method-disclosure-applied.** A pattern-of-statutory-replicability-and-
  method-disclosure applied-and-published; replicability-and-method-disclosure-decay pattern
  effective.
- **Anti-discrimination-statute-equality-applied-knowledge-domain.** Statutory-anti-discrimination
  applied-to-knowledge-domain with case-trend-as-statistical applied-statistical-effective.
- **Discipline-of-publication-discipline-applied-across-group-membership.** Patterns-of-
  discipline-statistical applied-across-group-membership-statistical; out-group-of-discipline-
  statistical by-coverage-equality-statistical.
